targets.name: ProperArc.originRecord_injective
targets.signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (c : ZMod n), ∀ r ≤ n, Function.Injective fun t => ProperArc.originRecord c r (↑t + 1)

targets.name: ProperArc.assemble_strict_parent
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) (r ell lo : ℕ) (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (s : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)),
  r ≤ n →
    F = ProperArc.arc c r →
      1 ≤ ell →
        ell < r →
          lo + ell ≤ r →
            s.origin = none →
              (∀ (i : ℕ), lo ≤ i → i < lo + ell → s.placed ↑i = some {c + ↑i}) →
                RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s (ProperArc.assembleWord lo ell) =
                  { placed := ProperArc.segmentPlacement c lo ell s.placed, origin := s.origin, chain := s.chain }

targets.name: ProperArc.run_originWord
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) (r t : ℕ),
  r < n →
    1 ≤ t →
      t < r →
        RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run (ProperArc.arc c r) (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.singletonExecution n)
            (ProperArc.originWord c r t) =
          { placed := ProperArc.boundaryPlacement c r, origin := some (ProperArc.originRecord c r t), chain := [] }

targets.name: ProperArc.originPrefix_no_early_registration
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) (r t : ℕ),
  r < n →
    1 ≤ t →
      t < r →
        ∀ (u v : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
          u ++ v = ProperArc.originPrefix c r t →
            (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run (ProperArc.arc c r) (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.singletonExecution n)
                  u).origin =
              none
